input.prompt: Warm indie-folk, 95 BPM, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft piano, swelling string section, gentle kick drum like a heartbeat, light brushed percussion. Intimate, breathy male-female duet vocals with warm harmonies on choruses. Nostalgic, grateful, hopeful late-night mood building to a bright, open final chorus, fading softly.
input.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mm, the lamp is on, the window's dark

[Verse 1]
One small prompt at half past two
Coffee cooling by the lamp
Claude found the words and wrote them through
Line by line, like a paper map

[Pre-Chorus]
And nothing here was made alone
Every piece came walking home

[Chorus]
Oh, so many minds, one open door
Each one bringing something more
Words and voices, light and sound
Made of everything I found
Oh-oh, made of everything

[Verse 2]
Another mind picked up the song
It gave these words a voice to hold
It laid the strings like morning gold
A kick drum heartbeat, slow and strong

[Pre-Chorus]
And nothing here was made alone
Every piece came walking home

[Chorus]
Oh, so many minds, one open door
Each one bringing something more
Words and voices, light and sound
Made of everything I found
Oh-oh, made of everything

[Bridge]
Frame by frame the pictures grow
Painted slowly, one by one
A little creature, clay and glow
Lifts its hand and waves hello

[Chorus]
Oh, so many minds, one single line
Your hands and theirs, your spark and mine
Words and voices, dawn and sound
Made of everything I found
Oh-oh, made of everything

[Outro]
Now the credits start to roll
I know who made me, name by name
But first there was a lamp, a door
And you, who typed the first small line
Thank you for the first small line
